newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick says Suharto link not tied to Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Barrick says Suharto link not tied to Bre-X.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp said on Friday that its association with a construction company run by the eldest daughter of the Indonesian president had nothing to do with the intrigue surrounding Bre-X Minerals Ltd.
The association was set up four months ago and was not linked to Bre-X's attempts to win permits for its Busang gold discovery from the Indonesian government, said Barrick spokesman Vince Borg.
"The partnership for us is to prepare for a potential mining development project," he said.
